summary.en: Cao Cao defeated the Qingzhou Yellow Turbans and incorporated their elite as the Qingzhou troops.

description.zh: 192 年，曹操入兖州，击败青州黄巾，收编降众三十余万，选其精锐组成青州兵，成为此后征战的核心力量。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。

place.zh: 江苏曲阿

summary.zh: 孙策渡江，击败刘繇，奠定江东基业。
summary.en: Sun Ce crossed the Yangtze, defeated Liu Yao, and laid the foundation of Jiangdong.

description.zh: 兴平二年（195）孙策以助袁术攻刘繇为名，自历阳渡江，兵五六千，先破横江、当利，转战牛渚、秣陵，击破笮融、薛礼，进至曲阿击走刘繇。孙策军令整肃，十余日间得兵二万余、马千余匹，威震江东。建安元年（196）又破严白虎、降王朗，自领会稽太守。
description.en: In 195 Sun Ce, nominally helping Yuan Shu against Liu Yao, crossed the Yangtze at Liyang with five or six thousand men, took Hengjiang and Dangli, fought through Niuzhu and Moling, defeated Ze Rong and Xue Li and drove Liu Yao from Qua. With strict discipline he gained over 20,000 troops and more than a thousand horses within ten days, overawing the Lower Yangtze. In 196 he defeated Yan Baihu, forced Wang Lang’s surrender and took the title of Kuaiji governor.

place.zh: 河南官渡

summary.zh: 曹操在官渡击败袁绍，统一北方的基础奠定。
summary.en: Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu, laying the basis for unifying the north.

description.zh: 建安五年（200）二月袁绍进军黎阳，四月曹操斩颜良、诛文丑；八月袁绍连营而进，逼官渡；十月袁绍运粮万余车屯乌巢，曹操用许攸之计，亲率步骑五千夜袭，焚其粮草，张郃、高览降曹，袁军崩溃，袁绍仅率八百骑渡河北走。曹操坑杀降卒七万余。官渡之战奠定了曹操统一北方的基础。
description.en: In the second month of 200 Yuan Shao advanced to Liyang and in the fourth month Cao Cao killed Yan Liang and Wen Chou. In the eighth month Yuan Shao closed up on Guandu in a long line of camps; in the tenth month, with over 10,000 grain carts at Wuchao, Cao Cao took Xu You’s advice, led 5,000 horse and foot on a night raid, burned the grain, and as Zhang He and Gao Lan surrendered the Yuan army collapsed, Yuan Shao crossing the Yellow River north with only 800 riders. Cao Cao buried over 70,000 prisoners. The battle laid the basis for Cao Cao’s unification of the north.

description.en: In 204, Cao Cao besieged Ye and diverted the Zhang River to flood it. Shen Pei held out for Yuan Shang, but the city eventually fell and Cao Cao took Ji Province. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

place.zh: 湖北当阳

summary.zh: 曹操轻骑追刘备于长坂坡，刘备败走。
summary.en: Cao Cao’s fast cavalry caught Liu Bei at Changban, and Liu Bei fled.

description.zh: 建安十三年（208）九月曹操至襄阳，闻刘备南走，弃辎重，率精骑五千急追，一日一夜行三百余里，在当阳长坂追上。刘备军众十余万、辎重数千辆，日行十余里，被冲散；刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑走汉津，会关羽水军退往夏口。赵云抱护后主，张飞据水断桥。
description.en: In the ninth month of 208 Cao Cao reached Xiangyang and, hearing that Liu Bei had gone south, abandoned his baggage and drove 5,000 picked cavalry over 300 li in a day and a night, catching him at Changban in Dangyang. Liu Bei’s column of over 100,000 people and thousands of carts, making only ten-odd li a day, was scattered; Liu Bei abandoned his family and fled with Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun and a few dozen riders to Hanjin, joining Guan Yu’s flotilla and withdrawing to Xiakou. Zhao Yun shielded the infant heir and Zhang Fei held the broken bridge.

summary.en: Lü Meng crossed the Yangtze in disguise and seized Jiangling, forcing Guan Yu’s retreat.

description.zh: 建安二十四年（219）关羽围樊城、后方空虚，吕蒙称病还建业，荐陆逊代屯陆口，使关羽放松戒备；关羽调后方兵赴樊城后，吕蒙自寻阳发兵，伏精兵于船中，使白衣摇橹作商贾，昼夜兼行，尽收江边屯候，遂袭公安、江陵。傅士仁、糜芳先后投降，关羽后方尽失，败走麦城。此役起点为寻阳，非陆口。
description.en: In 219, with Guan Yu besieging Fancheng and his rear thin, Lu Meng feigned illness and returned to Jianye, recommending Lu Xun to hold Lukou and lull Guan Yu; once Guan Yu drew his rear troops north, Lu Meng set out from Xunyang with picked men hidden in the ships, disguised the rowers as merchants, moved day and night, swept up the riverbank watch posts and seized Gong’an and Jiangling. Fu Shiren and Mi Fang surrendered in turn, Guan Yu lost his rear and was defeated at Maicheng. The starting point was Xunyang, not Lukou.

Ma Su abandoned the water source and camped on a hill; Zhang He cut his supply of water and defeated him, forcing Zhuge Liang to withdraw. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

place.zh: 安徽石亭

summary.zh: 陆逊在石亭大败曹休，吴军巩固江淮。
summary.en: Lu Xun defeated Cao Xiu at Shiting, securing the Wu position along the Huai and Yangtze.

description.zh: 黄武七年（228）五月鄱阳太守周鲂断发诈降，诱魏扬州牧曹休率步骑十万向皖城；八月孙权至皖口，以陆逊为大都督，朱桓、全琮为左右督，各督三万人迎击。陆逊自为中部，三道俱进，冲击曹休伏兵，追至夹石，斩获万余，牛马车辆军资略尽。曹休败走，赖贾逵疑兵接应才得脱，九月惭愤疽发而死。 皖口即今安庆山口乡，石亭在今潜山东北（一说怀宁或桐城境），两地相距约 30 公里。
description.en: In the fifth month of 228 the Poyang governor Zhou Fang cut off his hair in a feigned surrender, luring the Wei governor Cao Xiu with 100,000 horse and foot towards Wancheng. In the eighth month Sun Quan reached Wankou and made Lu Xun commander-in-chief, with Zhu Huan and Quan Cong as left and right commanders, each with 30,000 men. Lu Xun took the centre and advanced in three columns, breaking Cao Xiu’s ambush and pursuing to Jiashi, killing and capturing over 10,000 and taking nearly all his transport and stores. Cao Xiu escaped only through Jia Kui’s deceptive flags, and died of shame and a festering wound in the ninth month. Wankou is modern Shankou in Anqing; Shiting lies north-east of Qianshan (some accounts put it in Huaining or Tongcheng), about 30 km away.

summary.zh: 司马懿发动政变，控制曹魏朝政。
summary.en: Sima Yi launched a coup and took control of the Wei court.

description.zh: 魏正始十年（249）正月，曹爽兄弟陪魏帝曹芳出洛阳谒高平陵；司马懿以郭太后名义闭城门、占武库、控制禁军，并派曹爽所信之人劝其归降，指洛水为誓。曹爽回洛阳交出兵权，旋以谋反罪被族诛，司马氏专权自此始。
description.en: In the first month of 249 Cao Shuang and his brothers accompanied Emperor Cao Fang out of Luoyang to sacrifice at Gaopingling. Sima Yi, in the empress dowager’s name, closed the gates, seized the arsenal and controlled the palace guards, then sent men Cao Shuang trusted to offer terms, swearing by the Luo River. Cao Shuang returned to Luoyang and gave up his command, and was soon executed with his clan on a treason charge, beginning Sima family rule.

summary.en: Sun Quan moved his capital from Gong’an to E county, renaming it Wuchang, to face Liu Bei’s eastward advance.

description.zh: 建安二十六年（221）四月，孙权自公安迁都鄂县，改名武昌，以武昌、下雉、寻阳、阳新、柴桑、沙羡六县置武昌郡。此后至黄龙元年（229）还都建业，武昌为吴之国都。228 年石亭之战前，孙权即自武昌进驻皖口。
description.en: In the fourth month of 221 Sun Quan moved his capital from Gong’an to E county and renamed it Wuchang, creating Wuchang commandery from six counties including Wuchang, Xiazhi, Xunyang, Yangxin, Chaisang and Shaxian. Until the return to Jianye in 229 Wuchang was the Wu capital; before the battle of Shiting in 228 Sun Quan moved from Wuchang to Wankou.

summary.zh: 孙策渡浙江攻会稽，王朗败降，孙策自领会稽太守。
summary.en: Sun Ce crossed the Zhejiang, defeated Wang Lang and took the title of Kuaiji governor.

description.zh: 建安元年（196）孙策破吴郡严白虎后引兵渡浙江攻会稽。会稽太守王朗据固陵坚守，孙策数次渡水强攻不克；用叔父孙静之计，夜燃火为疑兵、分军由查渎道突袭高迁屯，斩周昕，王朗败走东冶，孙策追破之，王朗投降。孙策自领会稽太守，以吴景为丹杨太守、孙贲为豫章太守、朱治为吴郡太守。
description.en: In 196, after defeating Yan Baihu in Wu commandery, Sun Ce crossed the Zhejiang against Kuaiji. Governor Wang Lang held Guling and beat off several assaults; on the advice of his uncle Sun Jing, Sun Ce lit decoy fires at night and sent a column by the Chadu road to surprise Gaoqian tun, killing Zhou Xin. Wang Lang fled to Dongye, was routed again and surrendered. Sun Ce took the title of Kuaiji governor and appointed Wu Jing, Sun Ben and Zhu Zhi to Danyang, Yuzhang and Wu.

summary.zh: 曹操迎汉献帝自洛阳东迁许县，从此“奉天子以令不臣”，取得政治主动权。
summary.en: Cao Cao escorted Emperor Xian from Luoyang to Xu county, gaining the political initiative of acting in the emperor’s name.

description.zh: 建安元年（196）七月，献帝在杨奉、韩暹、董承等护送下还洛阳，宫室残破、百官乏食。曹操采纳荀彧“奉主上以从民望”之议，率军至洛阳，以洛阳残破、漕运艰难为由，于八月庚申（公历 10 月 7 日）奉车驾出轘辕东行，迁都许县；献帝以曹操为大将军，封武平侯。此后曹操以天子名义号令诸侯，在政治上取得对各路势力的优势。迎驾与迁都的具体日程，《三国志》《后汉书》所载略有出入，此处取通行说法。
description.en: In the seventh month of 196 Emperor Xian returned to a ruined Luoyang under the escort of Yang Feng, Han Xian and Dong Cheng. Cao Cao, advised by Xun Yu to support the emperor and win popular support, came to Luoyang. Citing the city’s ruin and supply difficulties, he moved the court east through Huanyuan on the gengshen day of the eighth month (7 October 196) to Xu county. The emperor made him general-in-chief and marquis of Wuping. Cao Cao thereafter acted in the emperor’s name, gaining a political advantage over rival warlords. The Sanguozhi and Hou Hanshu differ in detail; the conventional account is followed here.

place.zh: 荆州南阳宛城（今河南南阳）

summary.zh: 曹操南征张绣，张绣先降后叛，夜袭曹营，曹操败走，曹昂、曹安民、典韦战死。
summary.en: Cao Cao marched against Zhang Xiu. Zhang Xiu surrendered, then revolted and raided Cao’s camp; Cao fled, losing his son Cao Ang, nephew Cao Anmin and guard Dian Wei.

description.zh: 建安二年（197）正月，曹操率军至淯水，张绣举众投降。曹操纳张济遗孀为妾，张绣愤恨；又闻曹操欲杀己，遂用贾诩之计突袭曹营。曹操仓促应战，败走舞阴，长子曹昂、侄子曹安民、校尉典韦战死，曹操亦中流矢。此战使曹操失去继承人与宿卫大将，张绣则一度据南阳自守；建安四年张绣再降，官渡之战中为曹操所用。日期依《资治通鉴》系于建安二年正月，具体日份待考。
description.en: In the first month of 197 Cao Cao reached the Yu river and Zhang Xiu surrendered. Cao took Zhang Ji’s widow as a concubine, angering Zhang Xiu, who also learned that Cao planned to kill him. On Jia Xu’s advice Zhang Xiu raided Cao’s camp. Cao fled to Wuyin; his eldest son Cao Ang, nephew Cao Anmin and guard commander Dian Wei were killed, and Cao himself was wounded by a stray arrow. The defeat cost Cao his heir and his chief bodyguard, while Zhang Xiu held Nanyang for a time. Zhang surrendered again in 199 and served Cao at Guandu. The date follows the Zizhi Tongjian’s first month of 197; the exact day is uncertain.

place.en: Baima, Dong commandery (east of modern Hua county, Henan)

summary.zh: 袁绍遣颜良围白马，曹操声东击西解围，关羽斩颜良；又于延津诱敌斩文丑。
summary.en: Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang to besiege Baima. Cao Cao relieved it by a feint, Guan Yu killed Yan Liang, and Cao then lured and killed Wen Chou at Yanjin.

description.zh: 建安五年（200）二月，袁绍遣颜良攻东郡太守刘延于白马。四月，曹操用荀攸之计，佯向延津渡河，诱袁绍分兵，自率轻骑东袭白马；关羽于阵中斩颜良，解白马之围。曹操随即沿河西撤，袁绍渡河追击，曹操于延津南设伏，弃辎重诱敌，大破追兵，斩文丑。此役为官渡之战的前哨，袁绍连失颜良、文丑两员大将。
description.en: In the second month of 200 Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang against Liu Yan at Baima. In the fourth month Cao Cao, on Xun You’s advice, feigned a crossing at Yanjin to split Yuan’s forces, then led light cavalry east to relieve Baima; Guan Yu killed Yan Liang in the field. Cao withdrew along the river. Yuan crossed in pursuit, and Cao set an ambush south of Yanjin, abandoning baggage as bait and routing the pursuers, killing Wen Chou. The battles were the prelude to Guandu and cost Yuan Shao two of his best commanders.

place.en: Wuchao, Chenliu (southeast of modern Yanjin, Henan; some place it west of Fengqiu)

summary.zh: 许攸降曹献计，曹操夜袭乌巢，焚袁绍粮草，斩淳于琼，官渡战局逆转。
summary.en: Xu You defected and advised Cao Cao to raid Wuchao. Cao burned Yuan Shao’s grain, killed Chunyu Qiong and turned the tide at Guandu.

description.zh: 建安五年（200）十月，袁绍谋士许攸因家人犯法获罪，怒而降曹，告以袁绍粮草尽屯乌巢、守备不严。曹操留荀攸、曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，用袁军旗号夜行，直趋乌巢，围屯纵火。袁绍不听张郃救乌巢之议，仅遣轻骑救援，主力攻曹营不下；乌巢粮尽焚，淳于琼等被杀。袁军军心崩溃，张郃、高览降曹，袁绍仅率八百骑北渡。乌巢地望有延津、封丘等说，今取延津东南代表点。
description.en: In the tenth month of 200 Yuan Shao’s adviser Xu You, facing punishment over his family, defected to Cao Cao and revealed that Yuan’s grain was stored at Wuchao under weak guard. Cao left Xun You and Cao Hong to hold camp and led five thousand horse and foot under Yuan colors at night to Wuchao, surrounded the depot and set it ablaze. Yuan rejected Zhang He’s advice to relieve Wuchao, sent only light cavalry, and failed to take Cao’s camp. With the grain gone and Chunyu Qiong killed, Yuan’s army collapsed; Zhang He and Gao Lan surrendered and Yuan fled north with some eight hundred riders. The location of Wuchao is disputed between Yanjin and Fengqiu; a representative point southeast of Yanjin is used.

name.en: Guan Yu floods the seven armies

place.zh: 荆州襄阳樊城（今湖北襄阳樊城）

summary.zh: 关羽围樊城，汉水暴涨，于禁七军皆没，于禁降、庞德被杀，关羽威震华夏。
summary.en: Guan Yu besieged Fancheng. The Han river flooded and Yu Jin’s seven armies were destroyed; Yu Jin surrendered, Pang De was killed, and Guan Yu’s prestige peaked.

description.zh: 建安二十四年（219）七月，关羽率荆州军北伐，围曹仁于樊城，曹操遣于禁、庞德率七军救援。八月，汉水暴涨，于禁所部七军被淹，于禁投降，庞德力战被擒杀。关羽乘势围樊城、襄阳，许都以南群盗响应，曹操一度议迁都以避其锋。此役为关羽军事生涯的顶点，也直接促使孙权与曹操联合、吕蒙袭取荆州。
description.en: In the seventh month of 219 Guan Yu led the Jingzhou army north and besieged Cao Ren at Fancheng. Cao Cao sent Yu Jin and Pang De with seven armies to relieve it. In the eighth month the Han river flooded; Yu Jin’s seven armies were submerged, Yu Jin surrendered, and Pang De was captured and killed after a hard fight. Guan Yu pressed the siege of Fancheng and Xiangyang, bandits south of Xuchang responded, and Cao Cao briefly considered moving the capital. The victory was the height of Guan Yu’s career and prompted Sun Quan to ally with Cao Cao and send Lü Meng against Jingzhou.

summary.zh: 建安二十五年正月庚子，曹操病逝于洛阳，年六十六；曹丕嗣位，汉魏禅代进入倒计时。
summary.en: Cao Cao died at Luoyang in the first month of 220 aged sixty-six. Cao Pi succeeded him, and the Han–Wei abdication followed within the year.

description.zh: 建安二十五年（220）正月，曹操自汉中还至洛阳，庚子日（公历 1 月 23 日）病逝，年六十六。遗令薄葬、将士不得离屯。曹丕自邺城嗣魏王位，同年十月受汉献帝禅让，建立魏朝。曹操之死标志着汉末群雄时代的终结与三国鼎立的开端。《三国志》仅记“崩于洛阳”，未载明确死因，后世头风等说均无确证。
description.en: In the first month of 220 Cao Cao returned from Hanzhong to Luoyang and died there on the gengzi day (23 January 220), aged sixty-six. His will ordered a simple burial and forbade troops to leave their posts. Cao Pi succeeded as King of Wei from Ye and in the tenth month accepted Emperor Xian’s abdication, founding Wei. Cao’s death marks the end of the warlord era and the beginning of the Three Kingdoms. The Sanguozhi records only that he “died at Luoyang”; later explanations such as chronic headache are unproven.

place.zh: 豫州颍川繁阳亭（今河南临颍繁城）
place.en: Fanyang Pavilion, Yingchuan (modern Fancheng, Linying, Henan)

summary.zh: 曹丕在繁阳亭受汉献帝禅让，称帝建魏，改元黄初，定都洛阳，东汉灭亡。
summary.en: Cao Pi accepted Emperor Xian’s abdication at Fanyang Pavilion, founded Wei, changed the era to Huangchu and made Luoyang the capital, ending the Eastern Han.

description.zh: 延康元年（220）十月，汉献帝下诏禅位，曹丕三让后于十月辛未（公历 12 月 11 日）在颍川繁阳亭登坛受禅，改元黄初，国号魏，定都洛阳；十二月追尊曹操为武皇帝。汉朝四百余年统治至此结束，三国中的曹魏正式建立。受禅地点有繁阳亭、许昌等说，今从《三国志·文帝纪》裴注所引《献帝传》繁阳亭说。
description.en: In the tenth month of 220 Emperor Xian issued the abdication edict. After three ritual refusals Cao Pi ascended the altar at Fanyang Pavilion in Yingchuan on the xinwei day (11 December 220), changed the era to Huangchu, proclaimed the state of Wei and made Luoyang the capital; in the twelfth month Cao Cao was posthumously honoured as Emperor Wu. Four centuries of Han rule ended and Wei formally began. The site of the abdication is given as Fanyang Pavilion or Xuchang; the Fanyang account in the commentary to the Wendi ji is followed.

summary.zh: 刘备在成都武担山之南即皇帝位，国号汉，改元章武，以承汉祚。
summary.en: Liu Bei took the imperial throne south of Wudan Hill in Chengdu, proclaimed the state of Han and changed the era to Zhangwu.

description.zh: 章武元年（221）四月丙午（公历 5 月 15 日），刘备在成都武担山之南即皇帝位，国号仍为“汉”，改元章武，以诸葛亮为丞相。此前曹丕代汉，传言献帝遇害，刘备为之发丧，遂以汉室宗亲身份继承汉统，史称蜀汉。即位仪式在成都城内，无军事行军，故不设路线。
description.en: On the bingwu day of the fourth month of 221 (15 May 221) Liu Bei took the throne south of Wudan Hill in Chengdu. He kept the state name Han, changed the era to Zhangwu and made Zhuge Liang chancellor. After Cao Pi replaced the Han and rumours spread that Emperor Xian had been killed, Liu Bei held mourning and claimed the Han succession as a member of the imperial clan; historians call his state Shu Han. The ceremony took place inside Chengdu with no military march, so no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 孙权在武昌称帝，国号吴，改元黄龙；同年九月迁都建业。
summary.en: Sun Quan took the imperial throne at Wuchang, proclaimed the state of Wu and changed the era to Huanglong; in the ninth month he moved the capital to Jianye.

description.zh: 黄龙元年（229）四月丙申（公历 5 月 23 日），孙权在武昌（今湖北鄂州）即皇帝位，国号吴，改元黄龙，追尊孙坚为武烈皇帝、孙策为长沙桓王。此前孙权已据江东、取荆州、破刘备于夷陵，至此正式与魏、汉鼎足。同年秋九月，孙权迁都建业（今江苏南京），以陆逊辅太子孙登留守武昌。称帝后吴、蜀互遣使申盟，共约灭魏分天下。
description.en: On the bingshen day of the fourth month of 229 (23 May 229) Sun Quan took the throne at Wuchang (modern Ezhou, Hubei), proclaimed the state of Wu, changed the era to Huanglong, and posthumously honoured Sun Jian and Sun Ce. Having already held the Lower Yangzi, taken Jingzhou and defeated Liu Bei at Yiling, he now stood as the third sovereign. In the ninth month he moved the capital to Jianye (modern Nanjing), leaving Lu Xun to assist the crown prince Sun Deng at Wuchang. Wu and Shu exchanged envoys and renewed their alliance to divide Wei.

place.en: Dianchi, Yizhou commandery (modern Jinning, Kunming, Yunnan)

summary.zh: 诸葛亮率军南征，马忠、李恢分道并进，平定南中四郡，稳定蜀汉后方。
summary.en: Zhuge Liang campaigned in the south with Ma Zhong and Li Hui on separate axes, pacifying the four southern commanderies and securing Shu Han’s rear.

description.zh: 建兴三年（225）三月，诸葛亮率主力自成都南下，经僰道、越嶲，五月渡泸水（金沙江），深入南中；马忠攻牂牁，李恢攻益州郡，三路并进。诸葛亮采纳马谡“攻心为上”之策，对当地首领孟获七擒七纵（此说出自《华阳国志》《汉晋春秋》，《三国志》本传未载细节），南中四郡平定。战后蜀汉调整郡县、征调南中物资兵员，为随后的北伐提供后方。具体进军路线与“七擒”地点异说较多，本段为示意简化。
description.en: In the third month of 225 Zhuge Liang led the main force south from Chengdu through Bodao and Yuexi, crossed the Lu river (Jinsha) in the fifth month and entered the south. Ma Zhong attacked Zangke and Li Hui Yizhou commandery on separate axes. On Ma Su’s advice to “win hearts rather than cities”, Zhuge is said to have captured and released the local leader Meng Huo seven times—an account found in the Huayang Guozhi and Han Jin Chunqiu but not detailed in the Sanguozhi. The four commanderies were pacified; Shu Han reorganised counties and drew supplies and troops from the south for the northern expeditions. The route and the “seven captures” sites are disputed; this line is schematic.

summary.zh: 诸葛亮出散关围陈仓，郝昭坚守二十余日，蜀军粮尽退兵，斩魏追将王双。
summary.en: Zhuge Liang left Sanguan and besieged Chencang. Hao Zhao held for over twenty days; the Shu army withdrew for lack of food and killed the pursuing Wei general Wang Shuang.

description.zh: 建兴六年（228）冬，诸葛亮趁魏军东下、关中空虚，出散关围攻陈仓。魏将郝昭以千余人拒守，诸葛亮用云梯、冲车、地道等法攻城，郝昭随方拒之，二十余日不克。蜀军粮尽，又闻魏援军将至，遂退兵；魏将王双率骑追击，被诸葛亮回军斩杀。此役显示蜀军攻坚能力不足，也促使诸葛亮此后更重视粮运与陇右。陈仓城址在今陕西宝鸡陈仓区一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the winter of 228 Zhuge Liang took advantage of the Wei army’s move east and the weakness of the Guanzhong garrison to leave Sanguan and besiege Chencang. The Wei commander Hao Zhao held with about a thousand men; Zhuge used scaling ladders, battering rams and tunnels, and Hao countered each device. After more than twenty days the Shu army ran short of food and, hearing that relief was coming, withdrew. The Wei general Wang Shuang pursued and was killed when Zhuge turned on him. The siege exposed Shu’s weakness in reducing fortresses and pushed Zhuge to pay more attention to supply and the Longyou region. The site lies in modern Chencang district, Baoji; the point is schematic.

place.en: Xingshi, Hanzhong (north of modern Yang county, Shaanxi)

summary.zh: 曹爽率十余万攻汉中，王平据兴势拒守，费祎率援军断其后，魏军退走。
summary.en: Cao Shuang attacked Hanzhong with over 100,000 men. Wang Ping held Xingshi and Fei Yi cut the Wei line of retreat, forcing a withdrawal.

description.zh: 正始五年（244）三月，曹爽不听司马懿劝阻，率十余万人自骆谷攻汉中。蜀汉镇北大将军王平以不满三万之众，采纳护军刘敏之议，先据兴势险要，多张旗帜绵延百余里；曹爽军入谷后补给困难，牛马骡驴多死。费祎又率军自成都东援，进据三岭截断魏军退路，曹爽苦战得脱，死伤甚众。此役是曹爽声望由盛转衰的起点，也巩固了蜀汉汉中防线。
description.en: In the third month of 244 Cao Shuang, ignoring Sima Yi’s objections, led more than 100,000 men through Luo valley against Hanzhong. Wang Ping, with fewer than 30,000, followed the advice of the protector Liu Min and occupied the Xingshi defile first, spreading banners over a hundred li. Once in the valley Cao Shuang’s supply line failed and many transport animals died. Fei Yi brought reinforcements east from Chengdu and seized the Sanling passes, cutting the retreat; Cao Shuang escaped after hard fighting with heavy losses. The battle marked the turning point in Cao Shuang’s fortunes and secured Shu Han’s Hanzhong front.

name.en: Deng Ai crosses the Yinping trail

place.zh: 益州阴平（今甘肃文县）

summary.zh: 邓艾自阴平道行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道，破江油，直逼成都。
summary.en: Deng Ai crossed the Yinping trail through seven hundred li of uninhabited country, cut a road through the mountains, took Jiangyou and threatened Chengdu.

description.zh: 景元四年（263）十月，魏军三路伐蜀，钟会主力攻剑阁，姜维坚守不下。邓艾率偏师自阴平道，行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道、造作桥阁，山高谷深、粮运将匮，濒于危殆；至江油，蜀守将马邈投降。邓艾继续南下，破涪城，与诸葛瞻战于绵竹。此役绕过剑阁天险，是魏灭蜀的关键奇袭。阴平道具体路线异说较多，本段为示意简化。
description.en: In the tenth month of 263 the Wei army advanced in three columns. Zhong Hui’s main force was held at Jiange by Jiang Wei. Deng Ai took a detached force along the Yinping trail, crossing more than seven hundred li of uninhabited country, cutting a road and building bridges and galleries; with mountains high, valleys deep and supplies nearly exhausted, the column came close to disaster. At Jiangyou the Shu commander Ma Miao surrendered. Deng continued south, took Fu and fought Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu. The march bypassed the Jiange barrier and was the decisive stroke of the conquest of Shu. The exact Yinping route is disputed; this line is schematic.

place.zh: 益州广汉郡绵竹（今四川德阳绵竹）

summary.zh: 邓艾破诸葛瞻于绵竹，诸葛瞻父子战死，成都门户洞开，刘禅出降。
summary.en: Deng Ai defeated Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu; Zhuge Zhan and his son died, Chengdu lay open and Liu Shan surrendered.

description.zh: 景元四年（263）十一月，邓艾自江油南下，破涪城，蜀汉卫将军诸葛瞻率诸军拒于绵竹。诸葛瞻不听黄崇抢占险要之谏，列阵平地；邓艾遣子邓忠与师纂分左右夹击，蜀军大败，诸葛瞻及子诸葛尚、尚书张遵等战死。绵竹失守后，成都无险可守，刘禅采纳谯周之议，遣使向邓艾投降，蜀汉灭亡。绵竹故城在今四川德阳绵竹市一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the eleventh month of 263 Deng Ai advanced south from Jiangyou, took Fu, and met the Shu general Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu. Zhuge Zhan ignored Huang Chong’s advice to seize the high ground and drew up on open ground. Deng sent his son Deng Zhong and Shi Zuan to attack from both wings; the Shu army was routed and Zhuge Zhan, his son Zhuge Shang and the minister Zhang Zun were killed. With Mianzhu lost Chengdu had no defensible line; Liu Shan took Qiao Zhou’s advice, sent envoys to surrender to Deng Ai, and Shu Han ended. The old city lies near modern Mianzhu, Deyang; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州九江郡合肥新城（今安徽合肥）
place.en: Hefei New City, Jiujiang (modern Hefei, Anhui)

summary.zh: 孙权率十万攻合肥新城，守军拒守，吴军攻城不克、士卒多病而退。
summary.en: Sun Quan attacked Hefei New City with 100,000 men; the garrison held out and the Wu army withdrew after failing to take it and losing men to sickness.

description.zh: 青龙二年（234）五月，孙权乘诸葛亮出斜谷、魏军西顾之机，率十万之众攻合肥新城。魏征东将军满宠欲率军赴援，田豫等认为吴军大举而来、意在诱敌，劝其持重；守军据城拒守，吴军攻城二十余日不下，士卒多病，又闻魏明帝亲率大军东来，遂烧攻具退走。此役与同年诸葛亮五丈原之战相呼应，显示魏军两线作战仍能守住淮南。合肥新城为满宠所筑，故城在今合肥西北，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the fifth month of 234 Sun Quan, exploiting Zhuge Liang’s advance through Xie valley and Wei’s focus on the west, attacked Hefei New City with 100,000 men. The Wei general Man Chong wanted to march to its relief, but Tian Yu and others argued that the massive Wu move was a lure and advised caution. The garrison held the city; after more than twenty days the siege failed, sickness spread, and on hearing that Emperor Ming was coming east with the main army Sun burned his siege engines and withdrew. The siege echoed Zhuge Liang’s Wuzhang Plain campaign that year and showed that Wei could hold Huainan while fighting on two fronts. Man Chong built the new city northwest of modern Hefei; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州九江郡濡须口（今安徽无为东北）
place.en: Ruxukou, Jiujiang (northeast of modern Wuwei, Anhui)

summary.zh: 曹操率大军攻濡须口，孙权以舟师拒守，相持月余，曹操叹“生子当如孙仲谋”而退。
summary.en: Cao Cao attacked Ruxukou with a large army; Sun Quan held with his river fleet. After more than a month Cao withdrew, praising Sun as the kind of son one would want.

description.zh: 建安十八年（213）正月，曹操率步骑号四十万攻濡须口，攻破孙权江西营，俘都督公孙阳。孙权率七万拒之，以甘宁、吕蒙等分守要津，吴军舟船器仗整肃；相持月余，曹操见吴军严整，叹“生子当如孙仲谋”（见《吴主传》裴注引《吴历》），引军还。此役确立濡须坞为吴国长江北岸屏障，此后吴魏多次在此拉锯。濡须口地望在今安徽无为东北，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the first month of 213 Cao Cao attacked Ruxukou with a force claimed at 400,000 horse and foot, broke Sun Quan’s camp on the west bank of the river and captured the commander Gongsun Yang. Sun Quan held with 70,000 men, posting Gan Ning, Lü Meng and others at the crossings; his ships and arms were in good order. After more than a month Cao saw the discipline of the Wu army, remarked that one would want a son like Sun Quan (recorded in the Wu li cited in the commentary to the Wu zhu), and withdrew. The battle established Ruxukou as Wu’s shield north of the Yangzi and the two states contested it repeatedly. The site is northeast of modern Wuwei, Anhui; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州庐江郡皖城（今安徽潜山）

summary.zh: 孙权攻皖城，吕蒙荐甘宁为升城督，拂晓破城，俘魏将朱光。
summary.en: Sun Quan attacked Wancheng. On Lü Meng’s recommendation Gan Ning led the escalade, the city fell at dawn, and the Wei commander Zhu Guang was captured.

description.zh: 建安十九年（214）五月，孙权攻皖城。魏将朱光屯皖，大开稻田、招诱鄱阳贼帅为内应。吕蒙认为皖城肥沃，若稻熟则魏军势盛，劝孙权速攻；又荐甘宁为升城督，吕蒙以精锐继之。拂晓进攻，甘宁率先登城，吕蒙督兵继进，食时破城，俘朱光及男女数万。此役拔除魏军在江北的重要据点，与濡须坞共同构成吴国江淮防线。皖城故址在今安徽潜山，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the fifth month of 214 Sun Quan attacked Wancheng. The Wei commander Zhu Guang held the town, opened extensive rice fields and tried to win over bandit leaders of Poyang as internal allies. Lü Meng argued that Wancheng was fertile and that if the rice ripened Wei’s position would strengthen, so he urged a quick assault and recommended Gan Ning to lead the escalade with picked troops behind him. At dawn Gan Ning was first on the wall; Lü Meng followed and the city fell by breakfast time, with Zhu Guang and tens of thousands of people captured. The victory removed an important Wei foothold north of the river and, with Ruxukou, formed Wu’s Huai–Yangzi defence. The site is modern Qianshan, Anhui; the point is schematic.

name.en: Dispute over the three Jingzhou commanderies

place.zh: 荆州长沙郡益阳（今湖南益阳）

summary.zh: 孙权遣吕蒙取长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡，刘备引兵公安、关羽入益阳相争，后以湘水划界。
summary.en: Sun Quan sent Lü Meng to take Changsha, Lingling and Guiyang. Liu Bei moved to Gong’an and Guan Yu to Yiyang; the crisis ended with the Xiang river partition.

description.zh: 建安二十年（215），孙权以刘备已得益州为由，遣诸葛瑾索还荆州三郡，刘备不许。孙权遂遣吕蒙率军二万取长沙、零陵、桂阳，长沙、桂阳望风归服，零陵太守郝普坚守；刘备自成都引兵五万至公安，遣关羽入益阳，与吴军对峙。适曹操取汉中，刘备恐益州有失，遣使与孙权议和。此役未演成大战，但孙刘联盟出现裂痕，为 219 年吕蒙袭荆州埋下伏笔。益阳地望在今湖南益阳，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 215 Sun Quan, arguing that Liu Bei already held Yizhou, sent Zhuge Jin to demand the return of three Jingzhou commanderies; Liu refused. Sun then sent Lü Meng with 20,000 men against Changsha, Lingling and Guiyang. Changsha and Guiyang submitted; the Lingling governor Hao Pu held out. Liu Bei brought 50,000 men from Chengdu to Gong’an and sent Guan Yu to Yiyang, facing the Wu army. When Cao Cao took Hanzhong, Liu Bei, fearing for Yizhou, sued for peace. No great battle followed, but the alliance was strained and the way was prepared for Lü Meng’s raid on Jingzhou in 219. Yiyang is modern Yiyang, Hunan; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 孙刘以湘水为界平分荆州：江夏、长沙、桂阳属孙权，南郡、零陵、武陵属刘备。
summary.en: Sun and Liu divided Jingzhou at the Xiang river: Jiangxia, Changsha and Guiyang to Sun Quan; Nanjun, Lingling and Wuling to Liu Bei.

description.zh: 建安二十年（215），刘备因曹操取汉中、益州告急，遣使与孙权讲和。双方以湘水为界：江夏、长沙、桂阳三郡属孙权，南郡、零陵、武陵三郡属刘备。此约暂时缓和孙刘冲突，但联盟互信已损；孙权仍视荆州为必争之地，建安二十四年（219）吕蒙袭取荆州即在此背景之下。划界为政治协议，无军事行军，故不设路线；具体月份待考。
description.en: In 215, with Cao Cao in Hanzhong and Yizhou threatened, Liu Bei sued for peace. The two sides divided Jingzhou at the Xiang river: Jiangxia, Changsha and Guiyang went to Sun Quan; Nanjun, Lingling and Wuling to Liu Bei. The agreement eased the immediate crisis but damaged trust; Sun Quan still regarded Jingzhou as vital, and Lü Meng’s seizure of it in 219 followed from this. The partition was a political agreement with no military march, so no route is drawn; the exact month is uncertain.

place.zh: 徐州广陵郡广陵（今江苏扬州）

summary.zh: 曹丕率军至广陵，临江观兵，见江水盛涨、吴军严备，叹“吾骑万队，何所用之”，引军还。
summary.en: Cao Pi reached Guangling and reviewed his army by the Yangzi. Seeing the swollen river and Wu’s defences, he lamented that even ten thousand cavalry were useless and withdrew.

description.zh: 黄初五年（224）八月，曹丕率军东巡至广陵，临长江观兵，欲伐吴。吴军沿江严兵固守，舟船列于江上；时江水盛涨，曹丕见天险难越，叹“吾骑万队，何所用之”，遂引军还。此役未发生大规模接战，却显示曹魏在江淮水网地带难以发挥骑兵优势，也促使曹丕此后转向内政。广陵故址在今江苏扬州，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the eighth month of 224 Cao Pi toured east to Guangling and reviewed his army on the Yangzi, intending to attack Wu. Wu forces held the bank in strength with ships deployed on the river. The river was in flood; seeing that the natural barrier could not be crossed, Cao Pi remarked that even ten thousand cavalry would be of no use and withdrew. There was no large-scale fighting, but the episode showed that Wei’s cavalry could not be used to advantage in the Huai–Yangzi water country and pushed Cao Pi back toward domestic affairs. Guangling is modern Yangzhou, Jiangsu; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 黄初七年五月丁巳，曹丕病逝于洛阳，年四十；太子曹叡即位，曹真、曹休、陈群、司马懿辅政。
summary.en: Cao Pi died at Luoyang in the fifth month of 226 aged forty. Crown prince Cao Rui succeeded, with Cao Zhen, Cao Xiu, Chen Qun and Sima Yi as regents.

description.zh: 黄初七年（226）五月丁巳（公历 6 月 29 日），曹丕病逝于洛阳，年四十。太子曹叡即位，是为魏明帝；遗诏以曹真、曹休、陈群、司马懿为辅政大臣。曹丕在位期间完成汉魏禅代、定都洛阳、推行九品中正制，奠定曹魏制度基础。其去世后，曹魏进入曹叡与宗室、司马氏势力消长的阶段。去世无军事行军，故不设路线。
description.en: On the dingsi day of the fifth month of 226 (29 June 226) Cao Pi died at Luoyang aged forty. Crown prince Cao Rui succeeded as Emperor Ming; the will named Cao Zhen, Cao Xiu, Chen Qun and Sima Yi as regents. Cao Pi had completed the Han–Wei abdication, fixed the capital at Luoyang and promoted the nine-rank system, laying the institutional basis of Wei. After his death Wei entered a period of shifting power among Cao Rui, the imperial clan and the Sima family. There was no military march, so no route is drawn.

place.zh: 凉州陇西郡狄道（今甘肃临洮）

summary.zh: 姜维乘淮南二叛之机出陇西，大破魏将王经于洮西，进围狄道，陈泰、邓艾来救而退。
summary.en: Jiang Wei exploited the Huainan revolt to strike into Longxi, crushed Wang Jing at Taoxi and besieged Didao until Chen Tai and Deng Ai relieved it.

description.zh: 正元二年（255）八月，姜维乘魏淮南二叛、关中空虚之机，率军出陇西，直指狄道。魏雍州刺史王经率军迎战，姜维于洮西大破之，魏军死者数万，王经退保狄道。姜维乘胜围城，魏征西将军陈泰与邓艾率军救援，姜维粮尽退走。此役是姜维北伐中战果最大的一战，但未能拔除狄道，蜀军也消耗甚大。狄道故址在今甘肃临洮，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the eighth month of 255 Jiang Wei, exploiting the Huainan revolt and the weakened Guanzhong garrison, led his army into Longxi toward Didao. The Wei governor Wang Jing engaged him and was crushed at Taoxi; tens of thousands of Wei troops died and Wang Jing fell back on Didao. Jiang Wei besieged the city, but the Wei generals Chen Tai and Deng Ai came to its relief and Jiang withdrew when his supplies ran out. It was the greatest success of Jiang Wei’s northern campaigns, but Didao held and Shu’s forces were badly depleted. Didao is modern Lintao, Gansu; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 姜维出祁山，闻邓艾有备而退，邓艾追及于段谷，蜀军大败。
summary.en: Jiang Wei marched from Qishan but found Deng Ai prepared and withdrew; Deng Ai caught him at Duangu and routed the Shu army.

description.zh: 甘露元年（256）八月，姜维率军出祁山，闻邓艾已有防备，乃回军。邓艾先据武城山，又抢占段谷险要，邀击蜀军；姜维与邓艾战于段谷，大败，士卒星散，死者甚众。此役使姜维声望受损，蜀汉内部对其北伐的反对声增大。段谷地望在今甘肃天水东南，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the eighth month of 256 Jiang Wei marched from Qishan but learned that Deng Ai was prepared and turned back. Deng Ai first occupied Wucheng mountain and then seized the Duangu defile and ambushed the Shu army. Jiang Wei was heavily defeated at Duangu; his troops scattered and many died. The defeat damaged Jiang Wei’s reputation and strengthened opposition to his campaigns within Shu. Duangu lies southeast of modern Tianshui, Gansu; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州淮南郡寿春（今安徽寿县）

summary.zh: 诸葛诞据寿春反司马昭，遣子入吴求援；司马昭率大军围城，吴援不能入，城破，诸葛诞被杀。
summary.en: Zhuge Dan rose at Shouchun against Sima Zhao and sent his son to Wu for aid. Sima Zhao besieged the city, the Wu relief failed, and Zhuge Dan was killed when it fell.

description.zh: 甘露二年（257）五月，魏征东大将军诸葛诞据寿春反司马昭，杀扬州刺史乐綝，遣子诸葛靓入吴为质求援。司马昭挟魏帝曹髦、太后东征，率二十六万围寿春；吴遣朱异、丁奉等救援，被魏军击退。甘露三年（258）二月，寿春城破，诸葛诞突围被杀，淮南三叛至此平定。此役后司马氏清除淮南亲曹势力，代魏基础更加稳固。寿春故址在今安徽寿县，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the fifth month of 257 the Wei general Zhuge Dan rose at Shouchun against Sima Zhao, killed the Yangzhou governor Yue Lin and sent his son Zhuge Jing to Wu as a hostage for aid. Sima Zhao took Emperor Cao Mao and the empress dowager east and besieged Shouchun with 260,000 men; Wu sent Zhu Yi, Ding Feng and others, but their relief was driven off. In the second month of 258 the city fell; Zhuge Dan was killed trying to break out, ending the third Huainan revolt. The Sima family thus removed the pro-Cao forces in Huainan and strengthened its hold on Wei. Shouchun is modern Shou county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 凉州陇西郡侯和（今甘肃卓尼、临潭一带）

summary.zh: 姜维出汉、侯和攻魏，为邓艾所破，退屯沓中。
summary.en: Jiang Wei advanced through Han and Houhe against Wei but was defeated by Deng Ai and withdrew to Tazhong.

description.zh: 景耀五年（262），姜维率军出汉、侯和，攻魏陇西。魏征西将军邓艾据险拒守，大破蜀军；姜维退还沓中屯田，不敢再还成都。此役是姜维最后一次大规模北伐，蜀汉国力已疲，汉中防务亦因姜维改变“错守诸围”策略而削弱。侯和地望在今甘肃卓尼、临潭一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 262 Jiang Wei advanced through Han and Houhe against Wei’s Longxi. The Wei general Deng Ai held the strong points and routed the Shu army; Jiang Wei withdrew to Tazhong to farm and did not return to Chengdu. It was his last large northern campaign. Shu was exhausted, and the defence of Hanzhong had been weakened by Jiang Wei’s abandonment of the old forward-pasture strategy. Houhe lies in the modern Zhuoni–Lintan area of Gansu; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 凉州沓中（今甘肃舟曲西）

summary.zh: 姜维败于侯和后退屯沓中，种麦屯田，蜀汉汉中防务转弱。
summary.en: After his defeat at Houhe Jiang Wei withdrew to Tazhong to farm; Shu’s Hanzhong defences were left weaker.

description.zh: 景耀五年（262），姜维败于侯和，退屯沓中（今甘肃舟曲西），种麦屯田，不再回成都。姜维改变魏延、王平以来“错守诸围”的汉中防御策略，主张敛兵聚谷、诱敌深入，导致汉中外围要点空虚。这一调整在 263 年魏军大举伐蜀时暴露出弱点。沓中地望在今甘肃舟曲一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 262, defeated at Houhe, Jiang Wei withdrew to Tazhong (west of modern Zhouqu, Gansu), grew wheat and did not return to Chengdu. He abandoned the forward-pasture defence of Hanzhong used since Wei Yan and Wang Ping in favour of concentrating troops and luring the enemy in, leaving the outer strongpoints thin. The change exposed Shu when Wei invaded in 263. Tazhong lies near modern Zhouqu, Gansu; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 钟会率魏军主力攻汉中，姜维自沓中回军，退守剑阁，钟会攻之不克。
summary.en: Zhong Hui led the Wei main force against Hanzhong. Jiang Wei returned from Tazhong and held Jiange, which Zhong Hui could not take.

description.zh: 景元四年（263）九月，钟会率十余万魏军分道攻汉中，阳安关守将蒋舒投降，汉中失守。姜维自沓中回军，与廖化、张翼等合兵，退守剑阁天险；钟会大军攻剑阁，姜维拒守，魏军不能进。剑阁对峙使邓艾得以从阴平绕道，直接威胁成都。剑阁在今四川剑阁东北，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the ninth month of 263 Zhong Hui led more than 100,000 Wei troops in several columns against Hanzhong; the Yang’an pass commander Jiang Shu surrendered and Hanzhong fell. Jiang Wei returned from Tazhong, joined Liao Hua and Zhang Yi, and held the Jiange pass. Zhong Hui’s main army attacked but could not break through. The standoff at Jiange allowed Deng Ai to bypass it through Yinping and threaten Chengdu directly. Jiange lies northeast of modern Jiange, Sichuan; the point is schematic.

name.en: Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei’s revolt

place.zh: 益州成都（今四川成都）

summary.zh: 钟会诬邓艾谋反，与姜维谋据蜀反司马昭；事泄，魏军攻杀钟会、姜维，邓艾亦被杀。
summary.en: Zhong Hui accused Deng Ai of treason and plotted with Jiang Wei to hold Shu against Sima Zhao. The plot leaked; Wei troops killed Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei, and Deng Ai was also killed.

description.zh: 咸熙元年（264）正月，钟会入成都，诬邓艾谋反，用囚车押送洛阳。钟会自恃功高，与姜维密谋据蜀自立；姜维劝其尽杀魏军将领，再寻机复蜀。消息泄露，魏军将士哗变，攻杀钟会与姜维，邓艾父子亦在途中被杀。此乱虽平，但灭蜀三将俱亡，司马昭借机彻底控制伐蜀军权。事发成都城内，无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: In the first month of 264 Zhong Hui entered Chengdu, accused Deng Ai of treason and sent him to Luoyang in a prison cart. Proud of his achievement, Zhong plotted with Jiang Wei to hold Shu and declare independence; Jiang urged him to kill the Wei commanders and then look for a chance to restore Shu. The plot leaked, Wei troops mutinied, killed Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei, and Deng Ai and his son were killed on the road. The three conquerors of Shu were all dead, and Sima Zhao took full control of the army. The events took place inside Chengdu with no march, so no route is drawn.

name.en: Yang Hu takes charge at Xiangyang

place.zh: 荆州襄阳（今湖北襄阳）

summary.zh: 晋以羊祜都督荆州诸军事，镇襄阳；羊祜屯田积谷、绥怀吴人，与陆抗对峙。
summary.en: Jin appointed Yang Hu commander of Jingzhou at Xiangyang. He opened farms, stored grain, won over Wu border people and faced Lu Kang across the front.

description.zh: 泰始五年（269）十月，晋武帝以羊祜都督荆州诸军事，镇襄阳。羊祜减轻赋役、开屯田八百余顷，积蓄军粮；对吴边民以德怀之，降者不绝。吴将陆抗镇乐乡，与羊祜对峙，互有使节往来。羊祜的经营为日后晋灭吴奠定荆州方向的基础；他于 278 年去世，遗荐杜预自代。襄阳为晋吴荆州前线，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the tenth month of 269 Emperor Wu of Jin appointed Yang Hu commander of Jingzhou and stationed him at Xiangyang. Yang reduced taxes and corvée, opened more than eight hundred qing of military farms and stored grain; he treated Wu border people generously and defectors came steadily. The Wu general Lu Kang held Lexiang opposite him, and the two exchanged envoys. Yang’s work prepared the Jingzhou axis for the conquest of Wu; he died in 278 and recommended Du Yu as his successor. Xiangyang was the Jin–Wu front in Jingzhou; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 幽州辽东郡襄平（今辽宁辽阳）

summary.zh: 司马懿率四万讨公孙渊，围襄平，破城斩公孙渊父子，辽东平定。
summary.en: Sima Yi led 40,000 men against Gongsun Yuan, besieged Xiangping, took the city and killed Gongsun Yuan and his son, ending the Liaodong regime.

description.zh: 景初二年（238），魏明帝遣司马懿率四万讨辽东公孙渊。公孙渊于 237 年自立为燕王，置百官、诱鲜卑、侵魏边。司马懿自洛阳经邺、幽州东进，六月至辽东，围襄平；七月大雨，辽水暴涨，魏军与城中相持；八月雨止，司马懿筑土山、发石车攻城，城中粮尽，公孙渊突围被斩，辽东平定。此役消除曹魏东北后患，也显示司马懿的远征能力。襄平故址在今辽宁辽阳，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 238 Emperor Ming of Wei sent Sima Yi with 40,000 men against Gongsun Yuan in Liaodong. Gongsun Yuan had made himself King of Yan in 237, appointed officials, courted the Xianbei and raided Wei’s frontier. Sima Yi marched east from Luoyang through Ye and Youzhou, reached Liaodong in the sixth month and besieged Xiangping. In the seventh month heavy rain flooded the Liao river and the siege stalled; when the rain stopped in the eighth month Sima Yi built earthworks and stone-throwing engines, the city’s food ran out, Gongsun Yuan was killed trying to break out, and Liaodong was pacified. The campaign removed Wei’s northeastern rear threat and showed Sima Yi’s capacity for distant operations. Xiangping is modern Liaoyang, Liaoning; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州淮南郡芍陂（今安徽寿县南）

summary.zh: 吴将全琮率数万攻芍陂，魏将王凌、孙礼力战连日，吴军败退。
summary.en: The Wu general Quan Cong attacked Shaoqi with tens of thousands; Wei’s Wang Ling and Sun Li fought for days and drove him back.

description.zh: 正始二年（241）四月，吴将全琮率数万攻魏淮南，决芍陂水，与魏征东将军王凌、扬州刺史孙礼战于芍陂。王凌率援军赶到，力战连日，吴军败退；全琮子全绪、全端反攻掩护撤退。此役是吴魏淮南拉锯的一环，王凌因功封南乡侯、迁车骑将军。芍陂在今安徽寿县南，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the fourth month of 241 the Wu general Quan Cong led tens of thousands against Wei’s Huainan, broke the Shaoqi reservoir and fought the Wei commander Wang Ling and the Yangzhou governor Sun Li at Shaoqi. Wang Ling brought up reinforcements and fought for several days until the Wu army withdrew, covered by a counterattack by Quan Cong’s sons Quan Xu and Quan Duan. The battle was one round in the Wu–Wei contest over Huainan; Wang Ling was ennobled and promoted for the victory. Shaoqi lies south of modern Shou county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州淮南郡寿春（今安徽寿县）

summary.zh: 王凌与令狐愚谋立楚王曹彪，事泄；司马懿率军东征，王凌出降后饮药死。
summary.en: Wang Ling and Linghu Yu plotted to install Cao Biao as emperor; the plot leaked, Sima Yi marched east, and Wang Ling surrendered and took poison.

description.zh: 嘉平三年（251）四月，魏太尉王凌与兖州刺史令狐愚谋立楚王曹彪于许昌，以对抗司马氏。事泄后，司马懿率军自洛阳东下，王凌自缚出降，被押送洛阳，途中饮药死；曹彪亦被赐死。此役是淮南三叛的第一叛，司马氏借此清除淮南亲曹势力，代魏基础更加稳固。寿春故址在今安徽寿县，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the fourth month of 251 the Wei grand commandant Wang Ling and the Yanzhou governor Linghu Yu plotted to install Cao Biao, Prince of Chu, at Xuchang against the Sima family. The plot leaked; Sima Yi marched east from Luoyang, Wang Ling surrendered bound, was sent to Luoyang and took poison on the way; Cao Biao was also forced to die. It was the first of the three Huainan revolts, and the Sima family used it to clear pro-Cao forces in Huainan and strengthen its hold on Wei. Shouchun is modern Shou county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 景初三年正月丁亥，曹叡病逝，年三十六；曹芳即位，曹爽、司马懿辅政。
summary.en: Cao Rui died in the first month of 239 aged thirty-six. Cao Fang succeeded, with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi as regents.

description.zh: 景初三年（239）正月丁亥（公历 1 月 22 日），魏明帝曹叡病逝于洛阳，年三十六。养子曹芳即位，年八岁；遗诏以曹爽、司马懿辅政。曹叡之死使曹魏进入幼主临朝、宗室与司马氏争权的阶段，为 249 年高平陵之变埋下伏笔。去世无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: On the dinghai day of the first month of 239 (22 January 239) Emperor Ming of Wei, Cao Rui, died at Luoyang aged thirty-six. His adopted son Cao Fang succeeded at the age of eight, with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi as regents by the late emperor’s will. Cao Rui’s death opened a period of child emperors and rivalry between the imperial clan and the Sima family, leading to the Gaopingling coup of 249. There was no military march, so no route is drawn.

place.en: Nan’an commandery (southeast of modern Longxi, Gansu)

summary.zh: 姜维出石营、经董亭围南安，魏将陈泰解围，姜维粮尽退走。
summary.en: Jiang Wei marched through Shiying and Dongting to besiege Nan’an; Wei’s Chen Tai relieved it and Jiang withdrew when supplies ran out.

description.zh: 延熙十六年（253）夏，姜维率数万人出石营，经董亭，围南安。魏雍州刺史陈泰率军救援，进至洛门，姜维粮尽退走。此役是费祎死后姜维首次大规模北伐，虽未克城，但显示其用兵规模较前扩大。南安故址在今甘肃陇西东南，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the summer of 253 Jiang Wei led tens of thousands through Shiying and Dongting and besieged Nan’an. The Wei governor Chen Tai brought relief as far as Luomen, and Jiang Wei withdrew when his supplies ran out. It was Jiang Wei’s first large campaign after Fei Yi’s death; the city held, but the scale of his operations had grown. Nan’an lies southeast of modern Longxi, Gansu; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 姜维出陇西，狄道守将李简举城降；进围襄武，斩魏将徐质，迁三县民入蜀。
summary.en: Jiang Wei advanced into Longxi; Li Jian surrendered Didao, and Jiang Wei defeated and killed Xu Zhi at Xiangwu before moving three counties’ people to Shu.

description.zh: 延熙十七年（254），姜维出陇西，狄道守将李简举城降。姜维进围襄武，与魏将徐质交锋，斩徐质、破魏军；又乘胜招降河关、狄道、临洮三县，迁其民入蜀。此役是姜维北伐中少见的攻城斩将之战，但迁徙百姓也削弱了陇西的持续控制。狄道故址在今甘肃临洮，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 254 Jiang Wei advanced into Longxi and the Didao commander Li Jian surrendered the city. Jiang Wei then besieged Xiangwu, defeated the Wei general Xu Zhi and killed him; he also took the surrender of Heguan, Didao and Lintao and moved their people into Shu. It was one of the few northern campaigns in which Jiang Wei took a city and killed a Wei commander, though moving the population weakened lasting control of Longxi. Didao is modern Lintao, Gansu; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 魏帝曹髦率宿卫攻司马昭，被贾充指使成济弑于车下，司马氏另立曹奂。
summary.en: Emperor Cao Mao attacked Sima Zhao with palace guards and was killed by Cheng Ji on Jia Chong’s order; the Sima family installed Cao Huan.

description.zh: 甘露五年（260）五月，魏帝曹髦不甘司马昭专权，召侍中王沈、尚书王经、散骑常侍王业，称“司马昭之心，路人所知”，率宿卫数百人攻司马昭。中护军贾充指使太子舍人成济弑帝于车下。司马昭另立曹奂为帝，改元景元。此事使司马氏代魏的阻力进一步削弱，也让“弑君”成为司马氏难以洗刷的政治包袱。事发洛阳城内，无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: In the fifth month of 260 Emperor Cao Mao, unwilling to accept Sima Zhao’s domination, summoned Wang Shen, Wang Jing and Wang Ye and declared that “Sima Zhao’s heart is known to every passer-by”, then led several hundred palace guards against Sima Zhao. The guards commander Jia Chong ordered Cheng Ji to kill the emperor beside his chariot. Sima Zhao installed Cao Huan as emperor and changed the era to Jingyuan. The murder further weakened resistance to the Sima takeover but left an indelible political stain. The events took place inside Luoyang with no march, so no route is drawn.

name.en: Wang Hun takes command in Yangzhou

place.zh: 扬州淮南郡寿春（今安徽寿县）

summary.zh: 晋以王浑为安东将军、都督扬州诸军事，镇寿春，经营伐吴东线。
summary.en: Jin appointed Wang Hun general of Anton and commander of Yangzhou at Shouchun, building the eastern axis for the conquest of Wu.

description.zh: 咸宁三年（277）七月，晋武帝以王浑为安东将军、都督扬州诸军事，镇寿春。王浑到任后遣扬州刺史应绰攻破吴皖城屯田，焚其积谷、稻苗、船只，又巡视东境、察看地形，为伐吴做准备。279 年晋六路伐吴，王浑即自扬州出兵，破横江、逼牛渚。寿春故址在今安徽寿县，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the seventh month of 277 Emperor Wu appointed Wang Hun general of Anton and commander of Yangzhou at Shouchun. Wang Hun sent the Yangzhou governor Ying Chao to destroy Wu’s farms at Wancheng, burning grain, rice seedlings and ships, and toured the eastern frontier to study the terrain for the coming invasion. In 279, when Jin attacked on six axes, Wang Hun marched from Yangzhou, broke the defence at Hengjiang and pressed on Niuzhu. Shouchun is modern Shou county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 咸宁四年十一月辛卯，羊祜病逝于洛阳，遗荐杜预自代；两年后晋灭吴。
summary.en: Yang Hu died at Luoyang in the eleventh month of 278, recommending Du Yu as his successor; Jin conquered Wu two years later.

description.zh: 咸宁四年（278）十一月辛卯（公历 12 月 27 日），羊祜病逝于洛阳，年五十八。临终前推荐杜预接替自己都督荆州。羊祜镇襄阳十年，屯田积谷、怀柔吴人，为灭吴奠定基础；晋武帝在灭吴庆功时流泪说“此羊太傅之功也”。去世无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: On the xinmao day of the eleventh month of 278 (27 December 278) Yang Hu died at Luoyang aged fifty-eight. On his deathbed he recommended Du Yu to succeed him as commander of Jingzhou. In ten years at Xiangyang Yang Hu had opened military farms, stored grain and won over Wu’s border people, laying the basis for the conquest of Wu; at the victory feast Emperor Wu wept and said, “This is the achievement of Grand Tutor Yang.” There was no military march, so no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 晋武帝发六路大军伐吴：司马伷、王浑、王戎、胡奋、杜预、王濬水陆并进。
summary.en: Emperor Wu of Jin launched six columns against Wu under Sima Zhou, Wang Hun, Wang Rong, Hu Fen, Du Yu and Wang Jun.

description.zh: 咸宁五年（279）十一月，晋武帝下诏伐吴，六路并进：镇军将军司马伷出涂中，安东将军王浑出江西，建威将军王戎出武昌，平南将军胡奋出夏口，镇南大将军杜预出江陵，龙骧将军王濬率巴蜀水军顺流东下。贾充为大都督，节制诸军。吴主孙皓荒淫，吴军士气低落；次年正月起，晋军连破丹杨、西陵、江陵、武昌，三月王濬入建业，孙皓降。六路部署见《晋书·武帝纪》，具体进军日期以《通鉴》为准。
description.en: In the eleventh month of 279 Emperor Wu ordered the invasion of Wu on six axes: Sima Zhou from Tuzhong, Wang Hun from the west of the Yangzi, Wang Rong toward Wuchang, Hu Fen toward Xiakou, Du Yu from Jiangling, and Wang Jun with the Sichuan river fleet downstream. Jia Chong was overall commander. Wu’s emperor Sun Hao was dissolute and Wu morale low; from the first month of the next year Jin forces broke Danyang, Xiling, Jiangling and Wuchang, and in the third month Wang Jun entered Jianye and Sun Hao surrendered. The deployment follows the Jin shu, Wudi ji; dates follow the Zizhi Tongjian.

place.zh: 荆州南郡江陵（今湖北荆州）

summary.zh: 杜预攻江陵，吴督将伍延伪降，预攻克江陵，斩伍延，荆州诸城望风而降。
summary.en: Du Yu attacked Jiangling; the Wu commander Wu Yan feigned surrender, but Du Yu took the city, killed him and received the surrender of Jingzhou’s towns.

description.zh: 太康元年（280）二月，杜预率军自襄阳南下攻江陵。吴督将伍延据城拒守，伪请降以缓兵；杜预识破，督军急攻，克江陵，斩伍延。随后分兵徇江南诸城，沅、湘以南望风归附。杜预与王濬、王浑等会师，为晋灭吴奠定荆州方向的决定性战果。江陵故址在今湖北荆州，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the second month of 280 Du Yu marched south from Xiangyang against Jiangling. The Wu commander Wu Yan held the city and feigned surrender to gain time; Du Yu saw through it, pressed the attack, took Jiangling and killed Wu Yan. He then sent detachments through the towns south of the river, and the region south of the Yuan and Xiang submitted. Du Yu linked up with Wang Jun and Wang Hun, giving Jin the decisive result on the Jingzhou axis. Jiangling is modern Jingzhou, Hubei; the point is schematic.

name.en: Wang Jun breaks Danyang and Xiling

place.zh: 荆州宜都郡西陵（今湖北宜昌）

summary.zh: 王濬自成都顺流东下，克丹杨，破吴铁锁铁锥，定西陵。
summary.en: Wang Jun sailed east from Chengdu, took Danyang, broke Wu’s iron chains and spikes and secured Xiling.

description.zh: 太康元年（280）正月，王濬率巴蜀水军自成都东下，克吴丹杨（今湖北秭归东南），擒丹杨监盛纪。吴人在江碛要害处以铁锁横截、铁锥暗置江中；王濬作大筏、缚草人先行，除去铁锥，又以火炬烧断铁锁，船舰通行。随后定西陵，破吴军。此役突破吴国长江上游防线，为王濬顺流直下武昌、建业打开通道。西陵故址在今湖北宜昌，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the first month of 280 Wang Jun led the Sichuan river fleet east from Chengdu, took Wu’s Danyang (southeast of modern Zigui, Hubei) and captured its commander Sheng Ji. Wu had stretched iron chains across the river and hidden iron spikes in the water at the narrows; Wang Jun sent large rafts with straw men ahead to clear the spikes, then burned through the chains with torches and the fleet passed. He then secured Xiling and defeated the Wu forces. The breakthrough of Wu’s upper Yangzi defence opened the way downstream to Wuchang and Jianye. Xiling is modern Yichang, Hubei; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 荆州武昌郡武昌（今湖北鄂州）

summary.zh: 王濬顺流破夏口、武昌，吴军望风而降。
summary.en: Wang Jun swept downstream, took Xiakou and Wuchang, and the Wu forces surrendered without a fight.

description.zh: 太康元年（280）二月，王濬水军顺流东下，与胡奋、王戎等共平夏口、武昌。吴军在晋军连破西陵、江陵之后士气崩溃，武昌守军望风而降。王濬继续东下，直趋建业。此役使晋军控制长江中游，与王浑、杜预诸路形成合围建业之势。武昌故址在今湖北鄂州，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the second month of 280 Wang Jun’s fleet swept downstream and, with Hu Fen and Wang Rong, took Xiakou and Wuchang. After the fall of Xiling and Jiangling Wu morale collapsed and the Wuchang garrison surrendered without a fight. Wang Jun continued east toward Jianye. The campaign gave Jin control of the middle Yangzi and, with Wang Hun and Du Yu, closed the ring around Jianye. Wuchang is modern Ezhou, Hubei; the point is schematic.

sources.author: 房玄龄等
sources.note: 与胡奋、王戎共平夏口、武昌

place.zh: 扬州淮南郡横江（今安徽和县东南）
place.en: Hengjiang (southeast of modern He county, Anhui)

summary.zh: 王浑出扬州，破吴横江守军，进逼牛渚，吴丞相张悌渡江迎战。
summary.en: Wang Hun marched from Yangzhou, broke Wu’s Hengjiang defence and pressed on Niuzhu; Wu’s chancellor Zhang Ti crossed the river to meet him.

description.zh: 太康元年（280）二月，王浑率扬州晋军南下，破吴横江守军，进逼牛渚。吴主孙皓命丞相张悌督沈莹、诸葛靓、孙震率三万精兵渡江迎战。张悌围晋将张乔于杨荷，张乔伪降；随后吴军与王浑部战于板桥，大败。此役摧毁吴国最后一支机动精锐，建业门户洞开。横江在今安徽和县东南，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the second month of 280 Wang Hun led the Yangzhou army south, broke Wu’s defence at Hengjiang and pressed on Niuzhu. Sun Hao ordered Chancellor Zhang Ti, with Shen Ying, Zhuge Liang and Sun Zhen, to cross the river with 30,000 picked troops. Zhang Ti surrounded the Jin commander Zhang Qiao at Yanghe; Zhang Qiao feigned surrender, and the Wu army was then routed by Wang Hun’s forces at Banqiao. The battle destroyed Wu’s last mobile elite and left Jianye open. Hengjiang lies southeast of modern He county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

sources.author: 房玄龄等
sources.note: 率师出横江，破吴军，逼牛渚

sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 太康元年横江、板桥之战

place.zh: 扬州淮南郡板桥（今安徽含山、和县一带）

summary.zh: 吴丞相张悌督沈莹、诸葛靓等渡江迎战，大败于板桥，张悌、沈莹、孙震战死。
summary.en: Wu’s chancellor Zhang Ti crossed the river with Shen Ying and Zhuge Liang, was routed at Banqiao, and died with Shen Ying and Sun Zhen.

description.zh: 太康元年（280）三月，吴丞相张悌督丹阳太守沈莹、护军孙震、副军师诸葛靓率三万精兵渡江，迎击王浑。吴军围晋将张乔于杨荷，张乔兵少请降；张悌不听诸葛靓退保之计，继续进兵，与晋军战于板桥，大败。沈莹、孙震战死，张悌拒绝逃亡，力战而死，吴军死者七八千。此役后吴国再无可用之兵，王濬随即入建业。板桥地望在今安徽含山、和县一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the third month of 280 Wu’s chancellor Zhang Ti crossed the river with the Danyang governor Shen Ying, the guard commander Sun Zhen and the deputy strategist Zhuge Liang at the head of 30,000 picked troops to meet Wang Hun. The Wu army surrounded the Jin commander Zhang Qiao at Yanghe; Zhang Qiao, short of men, asked to surrender. Zhang Ti ignored Zhuge Liang’s advice to fall back, advanced, and was routed at Banqiao. Shen Ying and Sun Zhen were killed; Zhang Ti refused to flee and died fighting, and some seven or eight thousand Wu troops were lost. Wu had no army left, and Wang Jun entered Jianye soon after. Banqiao lies in the modern Hanshan–He county area of Anhui; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 冀州巨鹿郡界桥（今河北威县东）
place.en: Jieqiao, Julu (east of modern Wei county, Hebei)

summary.zh: 公孙瓒南攻冀州，袁绍以麴义八百先登、强弩千张大破白马义从于界桥。
summary.en: Gongsun Zan attacked Jizhou; Yuan Shao’s commander Qu Yi with 800 spearhead troops and massed crossbows shattered the White Horse cavalry at Jieqiao.

description.zh: 初平二年（191）冬，公孙瓒屯兵磐河，南攻冀州。袁绍亲率步兵数万迎战，令麴义以八百先登死士为前驱、强弩千张夹承其后。公孙瓒以白马义从等骑兵冲锋，麴义伏盾不动，待骑接近后同时奋起，强弩齐发，大破公孙瓒军，斩其将严纲。此役是袁绍夺取冀州、进而统一河北的关键一战，也是汉末军阀争夺地盘的第一场大会战。界桥在今河北威县东，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the winter of 191 Gongsun Zan camped at Panhe and attacked Jizhou. Yuan Shao met him with tens of thousands of infantry, placing Qu Yi’s 800 picked spearmen in front with a thousand crossbows behind. Gongsun Zan’s White Horse cavalry charged; Qu Yi’s men held behind their shields until the horsemen were close, then rose and loosed the crossbows, routing Gongsun’s army and killing his commander Yan Gang. The battle was key to Yuan Shao’s seizure of Jizhou and his eventual mastery of Hebei, and the first full-scale warlord battle of the late Han. Jieqiao lies east of modern Wei county, Hebei; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 冀州巨鹿郡界桥（今河北威县东）
place.en: Jieqiao, Julu (east of modern Wei county, Hebei)

summary.zh: 公孙瓒率白马义从南攻冀州，于界桥为袁绍部麴义以强弩击败。
summary.en: Gongsun Zan led his White Horse cavalry south into Jizhou and was beaten at Jieqiao by Yuan Shao’s crossbowmen under Qu Yi.

description.zh: 初平二年（191）冬，公孙瓒以弟公孙越之死归咎袁绍，屯兵磐河，举兵南攻冀州。其精锐“白马义从”在界桥南为袁绍将麴义的八百先登与千张强弩所破，大将严纲被斩，公孙瓒退走。此后双方又经龙凑、巨马水等战，互有胜负，最终由董卓借献帝之名遣使调停。界桥之战使公孙瓒由攻转守，为袁绍统一河北奠定基础。界桥在今河北威县东，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the winter of 191 Gongsun Zan, blaming Yuan Shao for his brother Gongsun Yue’s death, camped at Panhe and marched south into Jizhou. His elite White Horse cavalry was broken south of Jieqiao by Qu Yi’s 800 spearhead troops and a thousand crossbows; his commander Yan Gang was killed and Gongsun withdrew. Further fighting at Longcou and Juma river followed with mixed results until Dong Zhuo, in the emperor’s name, sent envoys to mediate. Jieqiao forced Gongsun onto the defensive and prepared Yuan Shao’s unification of Hebei. Jieqiao lies east of modern Wei county, Hebei; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 公孙瓒与幽州牧刘虞冲突，执杀刘虞，尽有幽州。
summary.en: Gongsun Zan clashed with Liu Yu, governor of Youzhou, captured and killed him and took control of the province.

description.zh: 初平四年（193）冬，公孙瓒与幽州牧刘虞矛盾激化。刘虞率兵攻瓒，为瓒所败；公孙瓒遂执刘虞，诬以谋反，杀之于蓟。刘虞在幽州颇得人心，其死使公孙瓒失去当地士民支持。此后公孙瓒据幽州，与袁绍长期争战，至 199 年为袁绍所灭。蓟在今北京，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the winter of 193 the conflict between Gongsun Zan and Liu Yu, governor of Youzhou, came to a head. Liu Yu attacked and was defeated; Gongsun Zan then seized him, accused him of treason and killed him at Ji. Liu Yu had been popular in Youzhou, and his death cost Gongsun the support of local gentry and people. Gongsun held Youzhou and fought Yuan Shao for years until his destruction in 199. Ji is modern Beijing; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 幽州涿郡易京（今河北雄县西北）
place.en: Yijing, Zhuo (northwest of modern Xiong county, Hebei)

summary.zh: 袁绍围公孙瓒于易京，公孙瓒自焚死，袁绍尽有幽州。
summary.en: Yuan Shao besieged Gongsun Zan at Yijing; Gongsun burned himself to death and Yuan took Youzhou.

description.zh: 建安四年（199）春，袁绍率军围攻公孙瓒于易京。公孙瓒筑楼橹、积谷自守，部将或被围或降；袁绍掘地道、焚楼橹，城破，公孙瓒自焚而死。至此袁绍据有冀、青、幽、并四州，成为北方最强势力。易京在今河北雄县西北，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the spring of 199 Yuan Shao besieged Gongsun Zan at Yijing. Gongsun had built towers and stored grain for a long defence, but his commanders were isolated or surrendered; Yuan dug tunnels and burned the towers, the city fell and Gongsun burned himself to death. Yuan Shao now held Ji, Qing, You and Bing, the strongest power in the north. Yijing lies northwest of modern Xiong county, Hebei; the point is schematic.

place.en: Yijing, Zhuo (northwest of modern Xiong county, Hebei)

summary.zh: 公孙瓒退守易京，为袁绍围困，城破自焚。
summary.en: Gongsun Zan withdrew to Yijing, was besieged by Yuan Shao and burned himself when the city fell.

description.zh: 建安四年（199）春，袁绍围公孙瓒于易京。公孙瓒曾筑高楼、积谷三百万斛，欲持久自守；但部将陆续被围或投降，袁绍又掘地道、焚楼橹，城破，公孙瓒先杀妻子姊妹，然后自焚。公孙瓒之死标志袁绍统一河北，也为其南下与曹操争锋铺平道路。易京在今河北雄县西北，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the spring of 199 Yuan Shao besieged Gongsun Zan at Yijing. Gongsun had built high towers and stored three million bushels of grain for a long defence, but his commanders were isolated or surrendered; Yuan dug tunnels and burned the towers, and when the city fell Gongsun killed his wife and sisters and then burned himself. His death marked Yuan Shao’s unification of Hebei and cleared the way for his southward clash with Cao Cao. Yijing lies northwest of modern Xiong county, Hebei; the point is schematic.

place.en: Guandu, Zhongmou (northeast of modern Zhongmou, Henan)

summary.zh: 袁绍率十万南下，进临官渡与曹操相持；乌巢粮焚后军溃，袁绍北归。
summary.en: Yuan Shao led 100,000 south and faced Cao Cao at Guandu; after his grain at Wuchao was burned his army collapsed and he fled north.

description.zh: 建安五年（200）八月，袁绍率十万之众南下，进临官渡，与曹操相持。袁绍不听沮授、田丰之谏，遣颜良、文丑先后败死；十月，曹操袭乌巢，焚其粮草，袁军军心崩溃，张郃、高览降曹，袁绍仅率八百骑北渡。官渡之战是汉末以少胜多的著名战例，奠定曹操统一北方的基础。官渡在今河南中牟东北，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the eighth month of 200 Yuan Shao led 100,000 men south and faced Cao Cao at Guandu. Ignoring Ju Shou and Tian Feng, he sent Yan Liang and Wen Chou to defeat and death; in the tenth month Cao raided Wuchao and burned his grain. Yuan’s army collapsed, Zhang He and Gao Lan surrendered, and Yuan fled north with only some eight hundred riders. Guandu, a famous victory of the few over the many, laid the basis for Cao Cao’s unification of the north. Guandu lies northeast of modern Zhongmou, Henan; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 刘表单骑入宜城，依靠蒯良、蒯越、蔡瑁平定宗贼，据襄阳领荆州。
summary.en: Liu Biao entered Jingzhou alone, won over Kuai Liang, Kuai Yue and Cai Mao, suppressed the local strongmen and took Jingzhou from Xiangyang.

description.zh: 初平元年（190），荆州刺史王叡为孙坚所杀，董卓以刘表继任。当时江南宗贼盛，袁术屯鲁阳，刘表无法直接上任，乃匿名单骑入宜城，延请蒯良、蒯越、蔡瑁共谋，诱杀宗贼首领，招降其众，遂据有荆州，徙治襄阳。刘表在荆州近二十年，保境安民，招纳士人，但晚年优柔寡断，未能应对曹操南征。襄阳为荆州治所，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 190 the Jingzhou inspector Wang Rui was killed by Sun Jian and Dong Zhuo appointed Liu Biao in his place. With local strongmen powerful and Yuan Shu holding Luyang, Liu could not take up office openly; he entered Yicheng alone and secretly, enlisted Kuai Liang, Kuai Yue and Cai Mao, had the strongmen’s leaders killed and their followers taken over, and so gained Jingzhou, moving the seat to Xiangyang. For nearly twenty years Liu kept the province peaceful and patronised scholars, but in old age he was indecisive and failed to meet Cao Cao’s invasion. Xiangyang was the seat of Jingzhou; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 刘备被曹操击败后南投刘表，刘表郊迎，使屯新野。
summary.en: After his defeat by Cao Cao, Liu Bei fled south to Liu Biao, who welcomed him and stationed him at Xinye.

description.zh: 建安六年（201），刘备在汝南为曹操所败，南投荆州刘表。刘表亲自郊迎，以上宾之礼待之，使刘备屯新野，为荆州北藩。刘备在新野招纳豪杰、三顾诸葛亮，逐步形成自己的核心集团；刘表则借刘备抵御曹操。此事件为 207 年三顾茅庐与 208 年赤壁之战埋下伏笔。新野在今河南新野，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 201 Liu Bei, defeated by Cao Cao in Runan, fled south to Liu Biao in Jingzhou. Liu Biao welcomed him in person, treated him as an honoured guest and stationed him at Xinye as the northern shield of Jingzhou. There Liu Bei gathered followers and made his three visits to Zhuge Liang, building his own core group, while Liu Biao used him against Cao Cao. The arrangement prepared the way for the Longzhong meeting of 207 and the Red Cliffs campaign of 208. Xinye is modern Xinye, Henan; the point is schematic.

summary.zh: 建安十三年八月，刘表病逝于襄阳，子刘琮嗣；不久刘琮降曹。
summary.en: Liu Biao died at Xiangyang in the eighth month of 208; his son Liu Cong succeeded and soon surrendered to Cao Cao.

description.zh: 建安十三年（208）八月，刘表病逝于襄阳，年六十七。长子刘琦与次子刘琮争嗣，蔡瑁、张允等拥立刘琮。同年九月，曹操南征，刘琮举州投降，刘备南走。刘表经营荆州近二十年，其死标志荆州割据的终结，也为赤壁之战揭开序幕。去世无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: In the eighth month of 208 Liu Biao died at Xiangyang aged sixty-seven. His elder son Liu Qi and younger son Liu Cong contested the succession, and Cai Mao and Zhang Yun backed Liu Cong. In the ninth month Cao Cao invaded and Liu Cong surrendered the province, while Liu Bei fled south. Liu Biao had ruled Jingzhou for nearly twenty years; his death ended its independence and opened the Red Cliffs campaign. There was no military march, so no route is drawn.

place.zh: 幽州辽东郡襄平（今辽宁辽阳）

summary.zh: 公孙度出任辽东太守，厉行威刑，东伐高句丽、西击乌桓，割据辽东。
summary.en: Gongsun Du became governor of Liaodong, ruled with severity, campaigned against Goguryeo and the Wuhuan and made the region his own.

description.zh: 初平元年（190），公孙度经同郡徐荣推荐，被董卓任为辽东太守。到任后厉行威刑，诛灭郡中豪强，东伐高句丽，西击乌桓，又渡海取东莱诸县，自立为辽东侯、平州牧。公孙氏据辽东近五十年，历公孙度、公孙康、公孙恭、公孙渊四世，至 238 年为司马懿所灭。襄平在今辽宁辽阳，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 190, on the recommendation of his fellow townsman Xu Rong, Gongsun Du was appointed governor of Liaodong by Dong Zhuo. He ruled severely, destroyed the local magnates, campaigned east against Goguryeo and west against the Wuhuan, crossed the sea to take counties in Donglai, and styled himself Marquis of Liaodong and governor of Pingzhou. The Gongsun held Liaodong for nearly fifty years through Gongsun Du, Gongsun Kang, Gongsun Gong and Gongsun Yuan until Sima Yi destroyed them in 238. Xiangping is modern Liaoyang, Liaoning; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 幽州辽东郡襄平（今辽宁辽阳）

summary.zh: 袁尚、袁熙奔辽东，公孙康斩之，传首曹操。
summary.en: Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi fled to Liaodong; Gongsun Kang killed them and sent their heads to Cao Cao.

description.zh: 建安十二年（207），曹操北征乌桓，白狼山之战后袁尚、袁熙奔辽东投公孙康。公孙康恐曹操来攻，又欲借二袁之首自保，遂设伏斩袁尚、袁熙，传首曹操。曹操因此不战而得辽东名义归附，北方基本统一。此事件无军事行军，故不设路线。襄平在今辽宁辽阳，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 207 Cao Cao campaigned north against the Wuhuan. After the battle of White Wolf Mountain, Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi fled to Liaodong and Gongsun Kang. Fearing Cao’s attack and seeking to protect himself with their heads, Gongsun Kang ambushed and killed the two Yuans and sent their heads to Cao Cao. Cao thus gained Liaodong’s nominal submission without fighting and completed the unification of the north. There was no military march, so no route is drawn. Xiangping is modern Liaoyang, Liaoning; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 幽州辽东郡襄平（今辽宁辽阳）

summary.zh: 司马懿围襄平，公孙渊坚守；八月城破，公孙渊父子被杀，公孙氏辽东亡。
summary.en: Sima Yi besieged Xiangping; Gongsun Yuan held out until the eighth month, when the city fell and he and his son were killed, ending Gongsun rule in Liaodong.

description.zh: 景初二年（238），魏明帝遣司马懿率四万讨公孙渊。公孙渊于 237 年自立燕王，闻魏军来，向吴求援未果，据襄平坚守。司马懿围城，七月大雨、辽水暴涨，双方相持；八月雨止，魏军筑土山、发石车攻城，城中粮尽，公孙渊突围被斩，公孙氏辽东政权灭亡。襄平在今辽宁辽阳，坐标为示意。
description.en: In 238 Emperor Ming of Wei sent Sima Yi with 40,000 men against Gongsun Yuan, who had made himself King of Yan in 237. Gongsun sought help from Wu without success and held Xiangping. Sima Yi besieged the city; in the seventh month heavy rain flooded the Liao and the siege stalled, but when the rain stopped in the eighth month the Wei army built earthworks and stone-throwing engines, the city’s food ran out, Gongsun Yuan was killed trying to break out, and the Gongsun regime in Liaodong ended. Xiangping is modern Liaoyang, Liaoning; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 扬州九江郡寿春（今安徽寿县）

summary.zh: 袁术被曹操、袁绍击败后东走淮南，据寿春，称雄江淮。
summary.en: After defeats by Cao Cao and Yuan Shao, Yuan Shu fled east to Huainan, held Shouchun and dominated the lower Huai region.

description.zh: 初平四年（193）至兴平元年（194），袁术在封丘等地为曹操、袁绍所败，率众东走淮南，据九江郡寿春，自称徐州伯，署置官吏，控制江淮。袁术据寿春后，与孙策、刘备等势力交错，成为淮南最大的割据力量，为其 197 年称帝奠定基础。寿春在今安徽寿县，坐标为示意。
description.en: From 193 to 194 Yuan Shu, defeated by Cao Cao and Yuan Shao at Fengqiu and elsewhere, led his followers east into Huainan and took Shouchun in Jiujiang. He styled himself Earl of Xuzhou, appointed officials and controlled the lower Huai. At Shouchun he stood between Sun Ce and Liu Bei and became the strongest power in Huainan, preparing the ground for his proclamation as emperor in 197. Shouchun is modern Shou county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

sources.note: 初平四年至兴平元年袁术据寿春

place.zh: 扬州九江郡寿春（今安徽寿县）

summary.zh: 袁术在寿春称帝，建号仲氏，置百官，为各方所讨。
summary.en: Yuan Shu proclaimed himself emperor at Shouchun as the Zhong dynasty, appointed a court and was attacked by the other powers.

description.zh: 建安二年（197）春，袁术用张炯符命，在寿春称帝，建号“仲氏”，置公卿百官，祠南北郊。此前袁术已据淮南，得孙坚部众与传国玉玺，自以应谶。称帝后孙策、吕布、曹操等相继反对，袁术陷入孤立，两年间屡败，199 年病死于江亭。称帝为政治事件，无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: In the spring of 197 Yuan Shu, using Zhang Jiong’s prophecy, proclaimed himself emperor at Shouchun as the “Zhong” dynasty, appointed a full court and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth. He already held Huainan and the imperial seal from Sun Jian’s followers and believed the omens pointed to him. Sun Ce, Lü Bu and Cao Cao all opposed him; isolated and repeatedly defeated, he died at Jiangting in 199. The proclamation was political with no march, so no route is drawn.

place.zh: 扬州九江郡江亭（今安徽寿县南）
place.en: Jiangting, Jiujiang (south of modern Shou county, Anhui)

summary.zh: 袁术众叛亲离，欲北投袁绍，途中被截，退至江亭，呕血而死。
summary.en: Abandoned by his followers, Yuan Shu tried to flee north to Yuan Shao, was blocked, retreated to Jiangting and died vomiting blood.

description.zh: 建安四年（199）六月，袁术在曹操、刘备等打击下众叛亲离，欲北投袁绍长子袁谭，途中被刘备、朱灵截断去路，退回寿春，行至江亭，粮尽暑热，呕血而死。仲氏政权灭亡，淮南归曹操。江亭在今安徽寿县南，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the sixth month of 199 Yuan Shu, abandoned by his followers after defeats by Cao Cao and Liu Bei, tried to go north to Yuan Tan, Yuan Shao’s eldest son. Liu Bei and Zhu Ling blocked the road; he turned back toward Shouchun and reached Jiangting, where with no food in the summer heat he vomited blood and died. The Zhong regime ended and Huainan passed to Cao Cao. Jiangting lies south of modern Shou county, Anhui; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 徐州下邳国下邳（今江苏睢宁）

summary.zh: 吕布乘刘备出征袁术之机，袭取下邳，自称徐州牧。
summary.en: While Liu Bei was campaigning against Yuan Shu, Lü Bu seized Xiapi and styled himself governor of Xuzhou.

description.zh: 建安元年（196）六月，刘备率军与袁术相持于淮阴、盱眙，吕布应袁术之约，自小沛袭取下邳，俘虏刘备妻子。刘备回军，吕布反客为主，自称徐州牧，使刘备屯小沛。此事件使刘备失去徐州，也为 198 年曹操围下邳、擒吕布埋下伏笔。下邳在今江苏睢宁，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the sixth month of 196, while Liu Bei faced Yuan Shu around Huaiyin and Xuyi, Lü Bu at Yuan Shu’s urging marched from Xiaopei and seized Xiapi, capturing Liu Bei’s family. Liu Bei returned, but Lü Bu took over as governor of Xuzhou and stationed Liu Bei at Xiaopei. Liu Bei thus lost Xuzhou, and the stage was set for Cao Cao’s siege of Xiapi and capture of Lü Bu in 198. Xiapi is modern Suining, Jiangsu; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 徐州下邳国下邳（今江苏睢宁）

summary.zh: 曹操围下邳，吕布部将叛降，吕布被擒杀。
summary.en: Cao Cao besieged Xiapi; Lü Bu’s commanders defected, and Lü Bu was captured and killed.

description.zh: 建安三年（198）十二月，曹操采纳荀攸、郭嘉之计，决泗水、沂水灌下邳。吕布部将侯成、宋宪、魏续叛降，吕布退守白门楼，被擒；曹操将其缢杀。吕布据徐州至此结束。下邳在今江苏睢宁，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the twelfth month of 198 Cao Cao, on Xun You and Guo Jia’s advice, breached the Si and Yi rivers to flood Xiapi. Lü Bu’s commanders Hou Cheng, Song Xian and Wei Xu defected; Lü Bu was taken at the White Gate tower and strangled on Cao Cao’s order. His hold on Xuzhou ended. Xiapi is modern Suining, Jiangsu; the point is schematic.

place.zh: 益州蜀郡成都（今四川成都）

summary.zh: 刘焉卒，刘璋继为益州牧，继续割据益州。
summary.en: After Liu Yan’s death, Liu Zhang succeeded as governor of Yizhou and continued the family’s hold on the province.

description.zh: 兴平元年（194），益州牧刘焉病卒，益州官吏赵韪等推举其子刘璋继任，朝廷诏为益州牧。刘璋温仁软弱，先平赵韪之乱，后与张鲁相攻。刘璋统治益州二十年，至 214 年为刘备所取代。继任无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: In 194 the governor of Yizhou, Liu Yan, died. The provincial officials under Zhao Wei put forward his son Liu Zhang, and the court confirmed him as governor. Liu Zhang was mild and weak; he first suppressed Zhao Wei’s revolt and then fought Zhang Lu. He ruled Yizhou for twenty years until Liu Bei replaced him in 214. There was no march, so no route is drawn.

sources.title: 《三国志·蜀书·刘二牧传》
sources.author: 陈寿
sources.note: 刘焉卒，刘璋继为益州牧

sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 兴平元年刘璋领益州

place.zh: 益州梓潼郡涪城（今四川绵阳）

summary.zh: 刘璋遣法正迎刘备入蜀，亲迎于涪城，刘备遂留驻益州。
summary.en: Liu Zhang sent Fa Zheng to invite Liu Bei into Shu and welcomed him at Fucheng; Liu Bei then stayed in Yizhou.

description.zh: 建安十六年（211）十二月，刘璋听张松、法正之议，遣法正迎刘备入蜀，欲借刘备击张鲁。刘备自荆州入益州，刘璋亲迎于涪城，相会百余日，资给甚厚。刘备北至葭萌后按兵不动，收买人心，为 212 年反攻益州做准备。涪城在今四川绵阳，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the twelfth month of 211 Liu Zhang, on Zhang Song and Fa Zheng’s advice, sent Fa Zheng to invite Liu Bei into Shu to help against Zhang Lu. Liu Bei came from Jingzhou; Liu Zhang welcomed him at Fucheng, feasted him for over a hundred days and supplied him generously. Liu Bei went north to Jiameng but then halted, winning local support and preparing to turn on Liu Zhang in 212. Fucheng is modern Mianyang, Sichuan; the point is schematic.

sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 建安十六年刘备入蜀

name.en: Liu Zhang surrenders to Liu Bei

place.zh: 益州蜀郡成都（今四川成都）

summary.zh: 刘备围成都，刘璋出降，益州归刘备。
summary.en: Liu Bei besieged Chengdu; Liu Zhang surrendered and Yizhou passed to Liu Bei.

description.zh: 建安十九年（214）夏，刘备围成都数十日，刘璋在简雍劝说下出降，刘备自领益州牧。刘备将刘璋迁往公安，益州自此成为蜀汉基业。成都为益州治所，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the summer of 214 Liu Bei besieged Chengdu for several weeks. Persuaded by Jian Yong, Liu Zhang surrendered, and Liu Bei took the governorship of Yizhou. Liu Zhang was moved to Gong’an, and Yizhou became the base of Shu Han. Chengdu was the provincial seat; the point is schematic.

sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 建安十九年刘璋降

name.en: Ma Chao and Han Sui rise

place.zh: 司隶弘农郡潼关（今陕西潼关）

summary.zh: 马超、韩遂等关西诸将起兵反曹，屯兵潼关，为曹操所破。
summary.en: Ma Chao, Han Sui and other Guanzhong generals rose against Cao Cao, massed at Tongguan and were defeated.

description.zh: 建安十六年（211）三月，曹操遣钟繇讨张鲁，关西诸将疑为袭己，马超、韩遂、侯选、程银等举兵反，屯潼关。七月，曹操亲征，八月至潼关，九月渡渭，大破关西联军。马超、韩遂退走凉州。此役是曹操统一关中的关键，也为马超后来投刘备埋下伏笔。潼关在今陕西潼关，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the third month of 211 Cao Cao sent Zhong Yao against Zhang Lu. The Guanzhong generals, suspecting a move against themselves, rose under Ma Chao, Han Sui, Hou Xuan and Cheng Yin and massed at Tongguan. Cao Cao came west in the seventh month, reached Tongguan in the eighth and crossed the Wei in the ninth, routing the allied armies. Ma Chao and Han Sui withdrew to Liangzhou. The campaign secured Guanzhong for Cao Cao and prepared Ma Chao’s later move to Liu Bei. Tongguan is modern Tongguan, Shaanxi; the point is schematic.

sources.title: 《三国志·蜀书·马超传》
sources.author: 陈寿
sources.note: 马超与韩遂等起兵、屯潼关

sources.title: 《三国志·魏书·武帝纪》
sources.author: 陈寿
sources.note: 建安十六年西征关右

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》卷六十六
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 建安十六年潼关之战

place.zh: 凉州汉阳郡冀城（今甘肃甘谷）

summary.zh: 渭南之战后，马超、韩遂退走凉州，关中归曹操。
summary.en: After the battle south of the Wei, Ma Chao and Han Sui withdrew to Liangzhou and Guanzhong passed to Cao Cao.

description.zh: 建安十六年（211）九月，曹操在渭南大破马超、韩遂联军，关中诸将或降或走。马超退走凉州，据冀城，后为夏侯渊所破，最终投奔张鲁、刘备。此役后曹操控制关中，为南下汉中、进攻益州奠定基础。凉州代表点取今甘肃甘谷一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the ninth month of 211 Cao Cao routed the allied armies of Ma Chao and Han Sui south of the Wei; the Guanzhong generals surrendered or fled. Ma Chao withdrew to Liangzhou and held Jicheng, later being driven out by Xiahou Yuan and eventually joining Zhang Lu and then Liu Bei. Cao Cao’s control of Guanzhong opened the way south to Hanzhong and Yizhou. A representative point near modern Gangu, Gansu, is used; it is schematic.

sources.note: 建安十六年马超退凉州

place.zh: 兖州东郡白马（今河南滑县东）
place.en: Baima, Dong commandery (east of modern Hua county, Henan)

summary.zh: 袁绍遣颜良围白马，关羽斩颜良；文丑追击，于延津被斩。
summary.en: Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang to besiege Baima; Guan Yu killed Yan Liang, and Wen Chou was killed pursuing at Yanjin.

description.zh: 建安五年（200）二月，袁绍遣颜良攻东郡太守刘延于白马。四月，曹操用荀攸声东击西之计，自延津佯渡，轻骑袭白马，关羽斩颜良。袁绍渡河追击，曹操于延津南设伏，弃辎重诱敌，斩文丑。此役是官渡之战的前哨，袁绍连失颜良、文丑两员大将。白马在今河南滑县东，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the second month of 200 Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang against Liu Yan at Baima. In the fourth month Cao Cao feigned a crossing at Yanjin and sent light cavalry to Baima, where Guan Yu killed Yan Liang. Yuan Shao crossed in pursuit; Cao Cao ambushed him south of Yanjin, using abandoned baggage as bait, and killed Wen Chou. The battles were the prelude to Guandu and cost Yuan Shao two of his best commanders. Baima lies east of modern Hua county, Henan; the point is schematic.

sources.author: 陈寿
sources.note: 袁绍遣颜良攻白马、文丑追击被斩

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》卷六十三
sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 建安五年白马延津之战

place.zh: 兖州东郡仓亭（今山东阳谷一带）
place.en: Cangting, Dong commandery (modern Yanggu area, Shandong)

summary.zh: 曹操在仓亭击破袁绍军，袁绍退归河北。
summary.en: Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao’s army at Cangting, and Yuan Shao withdrew to Hebei.

description.zh: 建安六年（201）四月，曹操就谷于安民，扬兵河上，击破袁绍仓亭军。袁绍自官渡败后，河北势力动摇，仓亭再败使其无力南下；202 年袁绍病卒，诸子内讧，曹操得以逐步平定河北。仓亭在今山东阳谷一带，坐标为示意。
description.en: In the fourth month of 201 Cao Cao moved his troops to Anmin for supplies, displayed his army on the river and defeated Yuan Shao’s force at Cangting. After Guandu Yuan’s hold on Hebei had weakened; the second defeat left him unable to move south. Yuan Shao died in 202 and his sons fell out, allowing Cao Cao to take Hebei step by step. Cangting lies in the modern Yanggu area, Shandong; the point is schematic.

sources.title: 《三国志·魏书·袁绍传》
sources.author: 陈寿
sources.note: 曹操击破袁绍仓亭军

sources.author: 司马光
sources.note: 建安六年仓亭之战

place.zh: 冀州魏郡邺（今河北临漳）

summary.zh: 建安七年五月，袁绍病卒于邺，诸子争立，河北渐为曹操所并。
summary.en: Yuan Shao died at Ye in the fifth month of 202; his sons contested the succession and Hebei gradually fell to Cao Cao.

description.zh: 建安七年（202）五月，袁绍病卒于邺。袁绍据河北四州，官渡败后势力未衰，但其死后长子袁谭、少子袁尚争立，河北分裂；曹操乘机各个击破，至 207 年平定河北。袁绍之死标志河北袁氏集团的转折。去世无行军，故不设路线。
description.en: In the fifth month of 202 Yuan Shao died at Ye. He had held the four provinces of Hebei and remained strong after Guandu, but after his death his eldest son Yuan Tan and youngest son Yuan Shang fought over the succession and Hebei split. Cao Cao exploited the division, defeating them one by one and pacifying Hebei by 207. Yuan Shao’s death marked the turning point of the Yuan clan in Hebei. There was no march, so no route is drawn.
